Why? Because the amount of energy required to melt ice is actually quite high. Your energy bill will go through the roof (literally in your case). It will be much, much, cheaper to haul water in to your property by truck (which is actually fairly cheap).

If you want to harvest snow, you can melt it passively using a solar collector and radiator. They work well, even in the winter provided it is always in the sun and the reservoir is insulated. Make sure to drain the collector at night before the pipes freeze.

On that note, you could probably have a solar water heater installed on the roof and piggy back off that. Also, snow never stays on my solar panels and either melts extremely quickly or slides right off.

Also, you'd want it as close as possible to the "Slush pool" reservoir and you wouldn't want to have that on the roof.
